description: Loss-making acquirer buying a profitable target all-cash. Exercises the F-4 NM (Not Meaningful) accretion convention: standalone EPS is negative, pro forma EPS improves, so the deal must report POSITIVE accretion with accretion_is_nm=true and must not get a red verdict. All monetary values in millions USD (project convention).

_workpaper: Standalone: acq EPS0 = -10/10 = -1.00; Year 1 standalone EPS = -1.00 x 1.03 = -1.03.
Anchored EBT (F-2): acq EBT0 = -10/0.75 = -13.3333 grows 3%; tgt EBT0 = 4.5/0.75 = 6.0 grows 5%.
Deal adjustments: PPA D&A = 0; foregone cash interest (F-3) = 40 x 0.043 = 1.72/yr; fees Y1 = 2% x 40 = 0.80.
Y1 pro forma EPS = -9.9533/10 = -0.99533 vs standalone -1.03: EPS improves by +$0.0347.
Old buggy behavior divided by SIGNED -1.03 and reported -3.4% (sign flipped) -> red verdict.
